rationale: Narrative caffeine review discusses withdrawal and neurological mechanisms without a new Parkinson beverage or fatigue comparison.
Clinical review describes brain-health effects without an original controlled Parkinson fatigue analysis.
General coffee benefit and risk review is not an original Parkinson symptom study.
Original rat imaging study measures A1 receptor tracer availability after caffeinated water and withdrawal. It does not measure clinical fatigue or brew.
Review concerns disease risk and models. No original brewed coffee fatigue contrast reported.

Author abstract and separately archived original Table 4 give imprecise association for frequency of total caffeine intake, without source beverage or brewing details. Full exposure wording remains gated.
Cochrane review cites one original isolated-caffeine fatigue trial, Postuma 2012. This is a citation trail to the same trial.
Original randomized caffeine capsule comparison gives week-six FSS estimate −2.85 with credible interval spanning zero. Both symptoms and individual preparation must be distinguished.
Own 106-item FFQ measures diet habits and Mediterranean pattern. Coffee in the discussion is cited from other cohorts. No own brewed coffee comparison with fatigue severity is reported.

Registered MED-PARK assigns a dietary pattern recommending non-decaf coffee and tea. Planned NMSS and MDS-UPDRS outcomes could provide clinical context, with no stand-alone coffee arm. Results remain open.
Overview of Parkinson multisystem pathophysiology without a new food–fatigue comparison.
A2A antagonist pharmacology review does not provide an original brewed coffee fatigue comparison.
Narrative review concerns cognition and nutrients, without an original Parkinson fatigue comparison.
Review spans multiple sclerosis fatigue and other neurodegenerative disorders. Followed the cited original NET-PD caffeine exposure and progression analysis without a fatigue coefficient.
Caffeine mechanism and clinical review supplies no independent Parkinson beverage fatigue comparison.
Duplicate appearance of the original capsule trial that already supplies the inconclusive FSS estimate. No separate coffee trial.
